text:
Type: freestanding full-length floor mirror
Use: checking an outfit, reflecting light; bedroom, hallway, dressing area, living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white powder-coated steel frame, mirror glass with a thin white border
Colors: white, silver mirror
Shape: tall narrow rounded-corner mirror on a slim tubular stand with a rear support that doubles as a clothes rail, light and open, slender
Feel: airy, practical, fresh, light
Goes with: white furniture, light wood floors, pastel textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms and hallways

product.name: KNAPPER
product.description: Tired in the mornings? You can save time by hanging tomorrows outfit behind the mirror.
